gen-gf-snowburst-one-fs-amulya: Snowburst One is a stencil face with wide bridges between letters and tall lowercase, loud and expressive. Amulya settles into modern sans with generous gaps in its curves, so paragraphs move along without strain.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-fs-plein: Chunky stencil drama up top: Snowburst One has wide bridges between letters and tall lowercase. Plein is the steady counterweight: clean sans-serif with a clear channel leading into each round letter.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-fs-spline-sans: Spline Sans reads friendly and open, with wide gaps where curves meet stems. Make Snowburst One small and its stencil bridges lose their punch, so it wants size to be loud.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-aclonica: Snowburst One cuts its letters like a stencil sheet, with wide bridges and tall lowercase. Aclonica stretches into long, widely spaced lines, so give it a modest size and let the heading carry the volume.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-alumni-sans-pins: Snowburst One is all stencil bridges and tall lowercase, expressive and bold. Alumni Sans Pinstripe runs tight and uniform, with no stroke contrast and big lowercase beside small capitals, so text feels compact.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-anaheim: Snowburst One brings stencil bridges between its letters and tall lowercase, loud and expressive. And Anaheim, with rounded forms open to the side, can take a slightly larger size since its glyphs huddle closely.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-arsenal: Stencil punch, tall lowercase: that is Snowburst One, wide bridges and all. Arsenal is plain sans with x-height close to cap height and a close-knit texture, so text glides along.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-carlito: Carlito has open round letters and tight, thread-on-a-spool spacing that stays clear at small sizes. Yet Snowburst One shouts with stencil bridges and tall lowercase, and that loud-versus-quiet gap is the draw.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-days-one: Loud stencil cuts, tall lowercase: Snowburst One does not whisper. Days One follows with spacing like rungs on a rope ladder and an x-height that fills the line, so both sound confident.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-farro: Expressive and bold, Snowburst One cuts stencil bridges between its letters and builds its lowercase tall. Farro, a sans with no stroke contrast and short ascenders, keeps text moving.
